text: PCRAFI is recognized for its extensive geospatial risk collection, PACRIS, which is one of the largest standardized repositories of hazard, exposure, and risk data for Pacific Island Countries. It has digitized over 500,000 buildings using high-resolution imagery, providing a robust foundation for risk modeling. The initiative also established a regional data-sharing platform, balancing regional efficiency with national accessibility, crucial for countries like Papua New Guinea with diverse capacities.
